story_type: hiker stuck overnight on a frozen mountain, Black Hawk hoist through ice-covered trees
hook: Stuck on a frozen mountain since the day before.
narration: He had been stuck on this frozen mountain since the day before.
He was a hiker from Australia, caught in the Huachuca Mountains of southern Arizona, in freezing temperatures.
Sheriff's deputies had searched for him, and could not find him.
So the sheriff's office asked for help, and a CBP Black Hawk crew launched from Tucson.
Over the ice-covered trees, a crew member swung out the door on the hoist.
He rode the cable all the way down to the snow.
A hoist lets a helicopter work over trees and steep slopes where it has no place to land.
On the ground, the rescuer clipped the hiker into a harness.
[short pause] Then the cable lifted them both up through the frozen trees.
outcome: The Black Hawk crew rescued the stranded hiker off the frozen mountain.
title: Stuck overnight on a frozen mountain
description:
On Feb. 24, 2023, a CBP Air and Marine Operations UH-60 Black Hawk crew from the Tucson Air Branch hoisted a stranded hiker out of the snow-covered Huachuca Mountains in southern Arizona after he spent a day stuck in freezing temperatures.
